args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Sunscreen (SPF 50+ recommended)
- Sunglasses
- Hat or cap for sun protection
- Beach towel
- Reef-safe sunscreen (required for Hanauma Bay)

CLOTHING:
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable fabrics)
- Light jacket or sweater (for cooler evenings)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Formal attire (for luau on June 16)

ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike on June 13)
  - Sturdy hiking shoes
  - Water bottle
  - Snacks
- Snorkeling gear (for Hanauma Bay on June 12)
  - Can bring your own or rent there
- Kayaking clothes (quick-dry recommended for Kailua Beach on June 18)

ELECTRONICS:
- Camera
- Phone with waterproof case
- Chargers
- Portable power bank
- Travel adapter if needed

DOCUMENTS:
- Travel documents (passport/ID, flight confirmations, hotel reservations)
- Travel insurance information
- Credit cards and cash
- Emergency contact information

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Reusable water bottle
- Small backpack for day trips
- Toiletries
- Medications
- Insect repellent
- Beach bag
